alt: 遊客一邊快步走、一邊匆匆拍照，沿途展品都只看一眼，沒有停下來了解細節。
scene_prompt: 走馬看花 means a superficial hurried look without deeper understanding. Modern museum garden tour. A hurried visitor walks briskly LEFT TO RIGHT past several interesting ORIGINAL botanical displays and small handcrafted sculptures, quickly snapping one phone photo without pausing; body motion and a simple walking stride suggest rushing. A magnifying lens and intricate leaf detail on a nearby educational display remain ignored. In contrast one quiet visitor far behind studies a single flower carefully, showing depth versus haste. No real artworks, readable exhibit labels, writing, brand phones or logos. Main hurried visitor does not inspect anything deeply; gentle travel humor, no literal horse required.
style_prompt: Create ONE original children's picture-book illustration for a Traditional Chinese idiom learning website. Landscape 3:2. Modern everyday setting when appropriate. NO text, letters, numerals, captions, titles, logos, watermarks or identifiable existing characters. Clear visual storytelling for elementary school readers and readable at mobile size. Hand-drawn delicate graphite pencil contours, soft translucent watercolor washes layered with colored-pencil grain and hatching on warm ivory textured paper. Restrained natural grass green, pale sky blue, warm earthy browns, generous ivory breathing room. No flat digital blocks, glossy rendering, 3D or imitation of a named artist. Scene:
